userStories.title: Closet import: pull a seller's existing Poshmark and Mercari listings through the extension
userStories.description: As a reseller switching from Vendoo or List Perfectly, I want my existing Poshmark and Mercari closets pulled into FlipDesk so that I do not retype 800 listings. Every competitor starts onboarding with 'import your listings'. FlipDesk imports eBay (POST /listings/pull), Shopify (POST /shopify/listings/pull) and CSV (flipdesk-import.ts), and nothing from the extension channels, which is where clothing resellers keep most of their inventory. The extension already reads the seller's own closet pages for sold-sync (extension-unified/sync/), so the reading half is adjacent work.
acceptanceCriteria: An 'Import my closet' action on /dashboard/flipdesk/import (src/pages/flipdesk/import.tsx) for Poshmark and Mercari, shown only when the extension is installed and the account has an active paid FlipDesk plan (the same gate as the lister in extension-unified/registry.js).

The extension reads only closet pages the seller opened themselves, under the same three refusals as extension-unified/sync/content.js: wrong host does nothing, a login wall reports not-signed-in and reads no rows, a human check stops and leaves the tab alone. No tabs.create, no navigation, no schedule (test/sync-manifest.test.cjs style guard).

Per listing it emits title, description, price, size, brand, the seller's stated condition, full-size photo URLs (through the adapter's URL-upgrade rule, verified per vault/10-ops/extension-adapter-verification.md so a thumbnail never passes as a photo), listing URL and platform listing id.

The server accepts the batch as a durable import run reusing the runs / effect rows / undo model in services/edge-functions/src/routes/flipdesk-import.ts, so a closed tab resumes and a bad import is one Undo away.

Each row creates an inventory_item with its origin recorded per src/lib/listing-origin.ts and one listings row (platform, listing_url, platform_listing_id, is_active). A re-run dedupes on (platform, platform_listing_id) and updates instead of duplicating.
Imported photos are copied into item-photos through validateImageUpload and stripImageMetadata (the CLAUDE.md storage rules), never hot-linked from the marketplace.

Imported live listings count against the plan's active-listing cap exactly as pulled eBay listings do (the cap check in flipdesk-listings.ts), and the 80% warning fires per vault/50-business/flipdesk-plan-gating.md.
Every new route has a case in services/edge-functions/src/tests/tenant-isolation_test.ts.
Disclosure copy before the first run says what is read and that it runs in the seller's own logged-in tab, added to src/lib/marketplace-disclosure.ts.
A PostHog event registered in src/lib/analytics-events.ts records install-to-first-imported-item time; the number appears on the activation funnel.

userStories.title: Edit sync on extension channels: a change in FlipDesk reaches Poshmark, Mercari and Vinted
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want a price, title, description or photo change made in FlipDesk to reach my Poshmark, Mercari and Vinted listings so that I have one place to edit. Today an edit reaches eBay and Shopify (native API updateListing) and nothing else: extension channels have list and delist flows only, so every cross-listed item goes stale the first time it is repriced. Vendoo and Crosslist both propagate edits.
acceptanceCriteria: extension-unified/lister/selectors.js gains a 'revise' flow per channel with its own enabled switch, version and lastVerified, under the same gate as list and delist (scripts/verify-lister-selectors.mjs refuses enabled:true without a lastVerified; the popup's 'Check selectors' covers the revise form).
MARKETPLACE_EXTENSION_FLOW in src/lib/constants.ts models revise alongside list and delist, and src/lib/__tests__/marketplace-mechanism.test.ts fails the build if the constant and selectors.js drift.

Saving a price, title, description or photo change on an item that has an extension-channel listing enqueues one revise job per channel in a pending-revise queue modeled on /listings/pending-delists, and the desktop extension drains it. Edits made on the phone go through the US-2481 mobile queue.

Until a revise is applied the listing row reads 'Stale on Poshmark since <date>' in src/pages/flipdesk/listings-table.tsx and item.tsx, and the extension popup shows the pending count. Never mark it applied before the marketplace confirms.

Bulk price drop (src/pages/flipdesk/listings-actions.ts, bulk-pricing.tsx) and the automation action price_drop_pct enqueue revises for extension channels instead of silently touching only API channels; the automation action log says queued vs applied.

Poshmark and Mercari verified first on live sell forms per vault/30-platform/closing-a-coverage-gap.md. Vinted and Grailed follow as their forms allow; an unverified channel reports 'edit manually' with a link to the listing, never a guess.
A queue state-machine test and a tenant-isolation_test.ts case for every new route.

userStories.title: Relist on extension channels, from the button and from automations
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want stale Poshmark and Mercari listings relisted from FlipDesk so that the days_listed_gt automation and the Relist button work on the channels where most of my closet lives, not only on eBay. Relist of ended listings exists for eBay (flipdesk-ebay.ts) and the automations engine has a relist action; neither reaches an extension channel.
acceptanceCriteria: Before building, record in this story's notes what the automations 'relist' action (services/edge-functions/src/routes/flipdesk-automations.ts) and the manual Relist button do today per channel, so the gap is stated from evidence.
An extension relist flow for Poshmark (their 'copy listing' relist) and Mercari, with the same switch / version / lastVerified model as list and delist.
The automations relist action and the days_listed_gt and no_views_in_days triggers enqueue extension relists; the action log distinguishes queued from applied.
A relist writes a new listings row and ends the old one, so sold-sync (services/edge-functions/src/lib/cross-listing-sale.ts) never matches the stale listing.
No bulk-relist endpoint exists today; add one that chunks like bulk-price and is Pro-gated under the existing autoRelist flag.
userStories.notes: [2026-09-01][CROSSLISTING][PRODUCT] Depends on the pending-queue shape from US-9202; build them in order. | [2026-09-01][CROSSLISTING][EVIDENCE for AC1, recorded before building] Automations 'relist' action (routes/flipdesk-automations.ts applyMatch, planned.kind relist): evaluated ONLY against eBay listings, because loadOwnerListings filters platform='ebay' AND listing_status='active'; for a match it withdraws the eBay offer (withdrawOffer; an already-ended offer is reconciled locally, US-2388), ends the local row (listing_status ended, is_active false), resyncs the item's listed status, writes after_json {listing_status:'ended', relist:true} with ebay_synced, and notifies 'ended and is back in Drafts, ready to relist'. It deliberately never republishes (fee + cap + no undo). Extension-channel listings are never seen by the engine, so days_listed_gt / no_views_in_days rules cannot fire on Poshmark, Mercari, Vinted or Grailed rows at all. Manual Relist button (src/pages/flipdesk/listings-table.tsx): on an ended row with eBay connected it opens the publish dialog with relist=true, which calls POST /api/flipdesk/ebay/listings/:id/relist -> relistOwnedListing (refuses eBay-originated rows, checks the activeListings cap, replenishes quantity, republishes the SAME listings row under its existing offer); the RotateCcw 'End this listing and relist as a new one' on active rows opens the same eBay dialog. Without an eBay connection the button is 'Mark' / 'List it', which only records by hand. So the manual path is eBay-only too: an ended Poshmark or Mercari row can be re-listed only by a fresh cross-post (a new list job from the composer, which creates a new row but never ends or removes the old one) or by hand. Gap stated: neither the button nor the automation reaches an extension channel, and nothing ends the old row when a seller relists by hand. | [2026-09-01][CROSSLISTING] Done, with the extension relist flows shipped OFF pending live verification. MODEL (lib/extension-relist.ts): a relist on Poshmark/Mercari is the seller's browser COPYING the live listing; createRelistDraft makes the NEW listings row at request time (draft, same item and draft_id group, platform_fields.relist_of = old id, forward pointer relist_pending_to on the old row so a second press cannot mint a second copy) and builds the payload (old listing URL to copy from, new row id, title/description/price); completeRelist runs only when the copy is live (the extension's live-URL watch posts new_listing_id + URL to POST /api/grading/public/relist-listed, or a drained queue row completes with listingUrl): the new row goes active with the URL, the OLD row is ended and, if it was live, gets delist_requested_at so the existing pending-delist queue removes it on the marketplace — so sold-sync never matches the stale row and still sees a sale of it in the window between. relistEligibility is pure and shared (extension platform, linked item, URL on record, active or ended, not already relisted). ROUTES: POST /api/flipdesk/listings/:id/relist-extension (cap-gated on activeListings for an ended row; ?queue=1 also enqueues for the desktop), POST /bulk-relist (Pro-gated feature:"autoRelist", the first server code path behind that flag; eBay rows via the publisher port's relist under their offer, extension rows via createRelistDraft + a kind:'relist' extension_work_queue row; per-row {mode:"ebay"|"queued"} and a queued count), extension-writeback completes a relist when the item's latest row for that platform carries relist_of, the mobile queue accepts kind relist (migration 00714 widens the CHECK; EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION 00714; manifest regenerated; PENDING_MIGRATIONS.md entry) and its /complete runs completeRelist from the row's own payload. AUTOMATIONS: rules whose action is relist now also evaluate the owner's LIVE extension-channel listings (loadOwnerExtensionListings; other actions still see eBay only), days_listed_gt fires there, no_views_in_days is guarded by a new viewsKnown fact so it never fires on a row with no performance sync; applyMatch on an extension row creates the copy row + queues the job and writes after_json {relist:true, queued:true, platform, new_listing_id} with ebay_synced false; the dry-run preview includes those rows; the log line reads "queued on poshmark" vs "ended, back in Drafts". EXTENSION: lister/selectors.js gains relist on poshmark and mercari (enabled:false, 2026.09.0-draft, lastVerified:null, required:["copy"], copy, navigatesTo the create/sell form); verify-lister-selectors gates it (copy-only pre-interaction, navigatesTo required, no enable without lastVerified) and reports a relist line; common.js GT.runRelistFlow (page 1 probe copy, record stage, click, defer; page 2 check navigatesTo, banner, return copied:true — it never claims a listing went live); job-store kind relist + RUNNABLE + wording, makeWatch carries relistNewListingId and queueId; background GT_LISTER_RELIST from the web (isValidRelistPayload host-pins the URL like a delist and requires newListingId), copied:true starts the live-URL watch, a captured URL is confirmed to the server (confirmRelistListed) and closes the queue row, drained relist rows open the old listing under the delist guard. WEB: use-relist-extension.ts (useRelistExtension: server row + payload → extension here or ?queue=1 for the desktop; useBulkRelist chunked like bulk price), listings-table Relist on ended AND live extension-channel rows (copy semantics in the title; toasts say the old listing is ended once the copy is live, never "relisted"), listings page "Relist" bulk button → bulkRelist with a native confirm (not undoable), automation log queued line, ExtensionQueueKind widened. TESTS: extension-relist_test.ts (eligibility, payload, kinds), extension-queue_test.ts now four kinds, tenant-isolation_test.ts gains relist-extension and bulk-relist cases (fixture TEST_USER_A_REVISE_LISTING_ID reused), extension relist-flow.test.cjs (declared/off, flow on a stub DOM, job store, watch, background wiring; all 41 extension test files pass), src/test/relist-extension.test.ts. Runbook: vault/30-platform/closing-a-coverage-gap.md Step 5c. AC1 evidence is the note above this one. NOT DONE / HONEST GAPS: (1) no channel's relist is enabled — Poshmark's copy_listing and Mercari's relist/copy controls are unverified guesses; run the runbook on a live owned listing, then flip enabled + lastVerified. (2) Vinted and Grailed have no relist flow yet (the story names Poshmark and Mercari). (3) The web has no queued-relist banner; a queued relist shows in the existing extension-queue surfaces and the copy row appears as a draft on the item. (4) Tenant-isolation lane not executed here (needs the full local stack). (5) A relist started from the web with the extension present opens the copy's form but the new row is confirmed only when the watch sees the posted URL; closing the tab before posting leaves a draft row the seller can delete.

userStories.title: Approve and list: phone photos in, one review card out, one button
userStories.description: As a reseller, I want to shoot photos and get one screen that shows the grade, measurements, item specifics, title, description, price and channels, with one Approve button, so that listing an item takes minutes instead of a walk through nine stages. Every piece exists (AutoLister extract and photo grouping, measure autofill, extract-aspects, listing-copy, pricing suggestions, cross-push) across about fifty FlipDesk pages; what is missing is the spine that runs them in one pass. This is the hours-saved story and the demo that sells FlipDesk.
acceptanceCriteria: A new default entry point: photos from web intake (src/pages/flipdesk/intake.tsx), iOS Capture and Android capture land on ONE review screen showing grade (or a 'grading, usually under a minute' state), measurements, item specifics, title, description, price (US-9205) and channel checkboxes.

One Approve publishes API channels (eBay, Shopify, Depop and Etsy once live) and queues extension channels. The screen says which run now and which wait for the desktop browser, in the words the US-2481 queue already uses.
Every block on the card links to 'Edit details' which opens the existing stage page; no stage page is removed.
Draft-quality checks (src/pages/flipdesk/draft-quality.ts) run before Approve and block only on hard failures: missing required photo, no price, no category.
An event registered in src/lib/analytics-events.ts records seconds from first photo to Approve; the overview page shows the seller's median.
Same flow on iOS and Android (run the parity-auditor agent before closing), because the phone is where photos start.
Default for accounts created after ship; existing accounts get a one-time 'Try the new flow' switch that can be turned back.

userStories.notes: [2026-09-01][CROSSLISTING][GROWTH] DECIDED GO by Dj 2026-09-01; ADR revised the same day. Recommendation was GO, capped, because the channel is how the incumbents were built and credits have not produced creators. | [2026-09-01][CROSSLISTING] PARTIAL, and the first thing to record is that this story's premise was wrong. THE RAILS ALREADY EXIST. US-1295 built the whole payout stack in migration 00310_affiliate_payouts.sql: affiliate_accounts (Stripe Connect Express, stripe_connect_account_id + payouts_enabled, onboarding mirroring the consignor account-link flow), affiliate_commissions (accrual ledger, accrued/paid/void, hold_until, UNIQUE on referral_event_id), affiliate_payouts (pending/processing/paid/failed/canceled, source auto|manual, stripe_transfer_id), lib/affiliate-payout.ts (the engine), lib/affiliate-payout-math.ts (pure math + tests), routes/jobs-affiliate-payouts.ts (batched sweep, job-secret auth, job lock, registered in cron-runs.ts at "15 */6 * * *"), routes/affiliate.ts (the dashboard feed, already reporting the 1099 threshold flag), and system_settings.affiliate_payout_config shipping mode:"off". So AC3 was already met before this story was written, except that the AC's "registered in rls-guard SERVICE_ROLE_ONLY with an owner_user_id column" does not apply to affiliate_payouts: it is policy-backed (owner SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE), and rls-guard only requires registration for tables with NO policies. I nearly rebuilt all of it -- I wrote a fresh affiliate-payout-math.ts over the existing one before checking, and restored it from HEAD; the original 22 tests pass. Read the module list above before touching this story again. WHAT WAS ACTUALLY MISSING, AND IS NOW BUILT: (1) THE ECONOMICS (AC4). The existing model paid a FLAT $5 per converted referral; the founder decided 20-30 percent of first-year subscription revenue capped per account. affiliate-payout-math.ts gains commission_model ("subscription_pct" by default, "flat" still reachable so rows accrued under it are not restated), commission_pct 25 (the band's midpoint), commission_cap_usd 250, commission_window_months 12, clampCommissionPct (an override outside 20-30 is clamped, so a config typo can neither pay 300% nor pay nothing), commissionForSubscriptionInvoice (floor-rounded, cap-truncated) and isWithinCommissionWindow. The cap is justified against the real prices: Starter $348/yr -> $87, Pro $708/yr -> $177, both paid in full; Business $1,188/yr would be $297, so $250 is the number that binds. Mirrored in src/lib/constants.ts CREATOR_AFFILIATE and in a new section of vault/50-business/pricing.md, with src/test/creator-affiliate.test.ts parsing all three and failing on drift. (2) THE CASH GATE (AC5). ADR section 4.5 says no cash before W-9 capture, and the engine could previously pay without one. planPayout now takes taxProfileComplete and DEFAULTS TO REFUSAL, so a caller that forgets the gate queues instead of paying; the engine reads hasCertifiedTaxProfile() at both decision sites (the balance planner and the transfer path) and fails closed on a read error. A missing profile QUEUES rather than skips, so the balance keeps accruing and pays the moment the form lands. Migration 00718 adds affiliate_tax_profiles: deny-all (RLS on, no policies), owner column owner_user_id per the service-role convention, registered in SERVICE_ROLE_ONLY in rls-guard_test.ts, legal name, entity type, address, tin_last4 as the only plaintext fragment and tin_encrypted holding an AES-256-GCM envelope the browser can never read; it also merges the four new commission keys into the affiliate_payout_config default with jsonb || so an edited deployment keeps its values. THE HOLD IS NOT "THE REFUND WINDOW". The AC says commissions pay "after the refund window"; pricing.md settled on 2026-08-02 that GradeThread has NO subscription refund window (fees are non-refundable, refunds are manual admin actions). The only real window is the 60-day billing-error window in refund.tsx section 3, so holdDays is 60 and both the constant and the note say why. STILL OPEN: (a) AC2, the creator programme is not yet SEPARATE from user referral -- there is no creator flag, no creator-specific terms and no separate consent, so today the config change would apply the percentage model to every affiliate; that separation is the next piece and should land before mode is ever flipped to batched. (b) AC5's other half: the W-9 CAPTURE surface (an authenticated edge route that encrypts the TIN and stamps certified_at, plus the form) is not built -- the table and the gate are, so the effect today is that no cash can move at all, which is exactly what the ADR asks for. (c) AC6, /partners and the creator dashboard are not built; routes/affiliate.ts already returns clicks, signups, paid and owed for the existing surface. (d) AC7 is operator work (source ten creators, log the outreach). (e) The accrual side still records the flat bounty on conversion: commissionForSubscriptionInvoice is pure and tested but nothing calls it yet, because the caller needs the referred account's paid invoices, which is the Stripe invoice webhook and belongs with the creator separation in (a). NOTHING PAYS ANYONE TODAY: mode is off, and the gate refuses without a certified profile even if it were on. | [2026-09-02][CROSSLISTING] Part 2: the SEPARATION (AC2), the W-9 SURFACE (AC5) and /partners (AC6). The gap the last note named as (a) is closed. MIGRATION 00719: affiliate_accounts gains program ('user' default | 'creator'), creator_terms_version, creator_terms_accepted_at, creator_approved_at, and TWO CHECKs -- program is one of the two values, and program='creator' is REFUSED without a recorded terms version and acceptance time, so the separate consent AC2 asks for is enforced by the database rather than remembered by a client. affiliate_commissions gains commission_model ('flat' default | 'subscription_pct'), referred_user_id and stripe_invoice_id; the old UNIQUE(referral_event_id) is swapped for two PARTIAL unique indexes -- (referral_event_id) WHERE stripe_invoice_id IS NULL keeps flat idempotency, (stripe_invoice_id) WHERE NOT NULL makes per-invoice accrual idempotent. The old constraint would have refused every renewal after the first, which is the bug that swap exists to prevent. CASH IS CREATOR-ONLY, BY DEFAULT: planAccrual takes program and skips with "not_creator" when it is anything but "creator", INCLUDING when the caller omits it -- the same fail-closed shape as the tax gate. planSubscriptionAccrual is the whole per-invoice decision in one pure function with seven named refusals (not_affiliate, not_creator, disabled, wrong_model, outside_window, cap_reached, zero_amount). The engine gains loadAffiliateProgram (fails closed to "user") and accrueSubscriptionCommission, which is now CALLED: webhooks.ts handleInvoicePaymentSucceeded fires it on subscription_create/subscription_cycle for seller invoices, wrapped so it can never fail a billing webhook (a throw would make Stripe redeliver the event and re-run the cycle reset). THE WINDOW ANCHORS ON THE FIRST COMMISSIONED INVOICE, not the click or the signup: a referral may subscribe months later, and the account's first year of PAYING is the only date the ledger can observe. ROUTES: GET /api/affiliate/creator (status: programme, accepted version vs current, approval, tax status with last4 only), POST /api/affiliate/creator/terms (version must be the CURRENT string or 409 -- consent to text somebody was shown before a revision is not consent to the live terms; acceptance is an APPLICATION and program stays 'user'), POST /api/affiliate/tax-profile (nine digits however punctuated, AES-GCM with AAD bound to the user id so a row copied to another account cannot be decrypted there, tin_last4 the only plaintext, certified_at stamped, US-only with an honest refusal for anything else since the 1099 path is the only one built). ADMISSION is operator-only: GET/POST /api/admin/growth/affiliate/creators[/:id/approve|remove], audit-logged, and approve refuses an account with no acceptance on record. Removal drops to 'user' and deliberately does NOT void earned commissions (terms clause 7). TERMS: vault/50-business/creator-affiliate-terms.md, version 2026-09-01, mirrored by CREATOR_AFFILIATE.termsVersion and the route constant; src/test/creator-affiliate.test.ts parses all three. WEB: /partners (public-routes + entry-server + routes/index, priority 0.6) states every number from CREATOR_AFFILIATE so the page cannot advertise a rate the ledger does not pay; a Creator tab on referrals.tsx carries the terms acceptance and the W-9 form (the TIN input clears itself the moment it is stored). NOT DONE: (a) the creator DASHBOARD half of AC6 -- clicks and signups still come from the existing /me and /payouts cards, which is the same data but not a creator-specific view; (b) AC7 is operator work; (c) the terms have not been read by a lawyer, which the note says in its own warning; (d) nothing has been exercised against a live stack -- routes are deno check/lint plus pure tests, and tenant-isolation cases were added but the lane needs the full local stack. NOTHING PAYS ANYONE TODAY: mode is off, no account is a creator, and the tax gate refuses without a certified profile.
